text:
Samira (People Ops): FYI we've published a concise handbook patch: updated PTO accrual examples, clarified parental leave for variable-hours roles, and a new flexible-work request workflow. Managers: please confirm you've reviewed and ensure your teams finish the 12-min course by Oct 12. Tracker + manager script in the sheet.

Eli (Benefits): Link? Also: does the accrual example change affect anniversary-based accruals?

Samira (People Ops): Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/handbook-oct-2026. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/handbook/oct-2026-patch. Accrual change only affects the cap language (section 3.2) not anniversary calculations.

Rosa (Legal): Reviewed. I tightened the variable-hours parent leave clause to reference "average weekly hours over 12 weeks" to avoid ambiguity. Added a short FAQ on conversions.

Dee (Recruiting): We'll update offer templates for hires after publish. For pending offers, are terms preserved?

Samira (People Ops): Yes, changes are prospective. Offers accepted before publish keep prior terms. Added that line to the confluence note.

Alex (Eng Manager): Can managers bulk-acknowledge after verifying? Also want a script for 1:1s with converting contractors.

Samira (People Ops): Yes, bulk ack is allowed after verification. Manager 1:1 script uploaded under "Manager assets" in the sheet.

Eli (Benefits): Added a note about stipend eligibility for conversions within 30 days of start date. Placed it in the tracker under "Benefits notes".

Rosa (Legal): I'll draft a brief Q&A covering stipend timing and bereavement definitions for managers to use.

Dee (Recruiting): I'll queue PRs to the offer repo for US/EU/APAC variants and flag recruiting leads.

ping-bot: Reminder scheduled: initial nudge Sep 28, follow-up Oct 5, final Oct 11 (status: queued).

Samira (People Ops): Thanks all. Final: course due Oct 12, manager confirmations by Oct 15. If any managers want a live 15-min walkthrough, add a time in the sheet under "Manager walkthrough" or reply here.
__notes: Single Slack thread. Chronological messages prefixed by sender names.
